headline: Bloom Energy Posts $27.1 Million Q3 Cash Outflow Despite Beating EPS Forecasts
summary: Bloom Energy delivered adjusted diluted earnings of 94 cents per share, surpassing consensus estimates of 69 cents, but recorded a third-quarter cash outflow of $27.1 million.
why: Bloom Energy manufactures solid oxide fuel cells for on-site power generation, a sector attracting growing interest for powering energy-intensive data centers.

impacts.name: Bloom Energy Corp
impacts.why: An adjusted earnings beat was countered by quarterly cash burn of $27.1 million.
